title: EtOH 48 Sample to 1mL Vial
author: Opentrons
materials: Specify your parameters on this page.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather equipment and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect a p50‑single channel pipette (GEN1), Opentrons 300 µL pipette tips, a custom 5 mL tube rack with tubes (samples 1‑24 for slot 1, samples 25‑48 for slot 4), and a custom 1 mL tube rack with tubes (samples 1‑24 for slot 2, samples 25‑48 for slot 5).

steps.title: Specify protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Open the protocol page and enter any required parameters as prompted.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the EtOH 48 Sample to 1 mL Vial protocol from the provided link.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons OT App, upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the robot deck according to the map: Slot 1 – custom 5 mL tube rack (samples 1‑24); Slot 2 – custom 1 mL tube rack (samples 1‑24); Slot 4 – custom 5 mL tube rack (samples 25‑48); Slot 5 – custom 1 mL tube rack (samples 25‑48); Slot 7 – Opentrons 300 µL tip rack.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for the tip rack, source racks, destination racks, and the p50‑single channel pipette.

steps.title: Transfer 50 µL EtOH per sample
steps.instruction: The protocol will use the p50‑single channel pipette to aspirate 50 µL of EtOH from each source tube in the 5 mL rack and dispense it into the matching destination tube in the 1 mL rack for all 48 samples.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a fresh 300 µL tip.
Aspirate 50 µL EtOH from the source tube.
Dispense 50 µL into the corresponding destination tube.
Repeat for each of the 48 samples.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: In the OT App, press “Run” to execute the transfer steps on the robot.
